definitions.true: A recorded cold-session answer from the named engine explicitly names Ecowoods or includes a link to ecowoods.ca.
definitions.false: A recorded cold-session answer was inspected and did not name or link Ecowoods.
definitions.null: No qualifying cold-session result has been captured for this engine-query pair.

measurement_policy.evidence_rule: A cited=true value requires a captured answer excerpt and a source/session reference. A cited=false value requires evidence that the relevant answer was inspected. Never infer either value from an index_hit, a target URL, ranking assumptions, a competitor list, or site publication alone.
measurement_policy.index_hit_rule: index_hit describes only the web-index observation recorded for the row. It is not evidence of an AI engine citation and must not change cited.
cold_session_requirements: Start a new, context-free session in the named engine for the exact query.
Record the exact query submitted and the date/time of the observation.
Record the engine/product surface and whether web search or grounding was enabled, where visible.
Inspect the answer and any source/citation links actually shown.
Set cited=true only if Ecowoods is named or ecowoods.ca is linked in that answer or its displayed sources.
Set cited=false only after inspecting a valid answer that does not cite or name Ecowoods.
Leave cited=null when the session cannot be run, the result cannot be inspected, or evidence is ambiguous.
Record the observed citation position only when the answer visibly establishes it; otherwise leave position null.

measurement_summary.interpretation: The current file contains a complete 33-query x 4-engine observation matrix, but no qualifying AI-engine citation outcomes have been measured. Index observations for m1, m2, and m8 are not citations.

fields_added_to_each_row.citation_status: unmeasured until a qualifying cold session is captured; use cited, not_cited, or unmeasured after observation.
fields_added_to_each_row.citation_checked_at: ISO 8601 timestamp for the actual engine session; null until sampled.
fields_added_to_each_row.citation_evidence_url: A URL to the inspected answer/source capture, where available; null until sampled.
fields_added_to_each_row.citation_excerpt: Short exact excerpt showing whether Ecowoods is named/linked; null until sampled.
fields_added_to_each_row.session_context: Engine product/surface and relevant search/grounding context; null until sampled.

observation_evidence_contract.position_rule: position is null unless the inspected answer makes a citation position observable. Never use ranking guesses or search-index position.
observation_evidence_contract.competitor_rule: Competitors are the recorded comparison set for the query, not proof that those sites were cited in the current engine session.
